Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a distinct shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the right (away from the affected side). This radiographic pattern is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion (or pyothorax/hydropneumothorax as suggested by the history), which exerts mass effect pushing structures to the contralateral side, whereas lung collapse or fibrosis would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity.
